About us

A practical, welcoming cafe for Roy Bridge

Glen Roy Cafe is being refreshed as a village cafe, small shop and community asset.

What we are trying to build

The goal is not to overcomplicate the place. The cafe should be reliable, friendly and useful: good drinks, straightforward food, local staples and a space that people are glad exists.

We are also interested in carefully chosen evening events, music and community use where it fits the village and the building.

Our priorities

  • Regular opening hours
  • Good basics done consistently
  • Warm service without fuss
  • Support for locals and travellers

A friendly village cafe in Roy Bridge serving coffee, tea, baking, sandwiches and useful local staples.
